sources.entry: texifier - Great LaTeX editor for Mac with auto-update PDF and autocomplete LaTeX commands.

summary.name: Texifier
summary.one_liner: Texifier is a LaTeX editor for macOS and iOS (with Windows coming soon) that combines a syntax-highlighting editor with a live-updating integrated PDF viewer; it was formerly called Texpad.
use_cases: Writing academic papers in LaTeX on a Mac
Writing LaTeX on an iPad or iPhone
Managing multi-file LaTeX projects with subfiles and images
Tracking TODO sections and LaTeX errors while writing
Previewing LaTeX output live as you type
summary.what_it_does: Texifier is a LaTeX editor with a syntax-highlighting editor and autocomplete for LaTeX commands. It includes a built-in PDF viewer that renders the output and updates as you type, with dark mode support and scroll-lock between the editor and PDF. A sidebar shows document structure, project files, TODO tags, and a file browser for drag-and-drop inclusion. It also parses LaTeX errors into a list alongside the full log, and offers search across the whole document including subfiles.
notable: Live typesetter that renders the PDF as you type
Sidebar with document outline, project files, TODO tags and error list
Built-in PDF viewer with scroll-lock and dark mode
caveats: Windows version is not yet released (listed as coming soon, beta sign-up)
macOS offers a free demo to try; full purchase is implied by 'buy now' but pricing is not stated on the page
Full dark mode support is listed for macOS only
